results.question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?

results.evidence: average price per single item = Total(price) / Total(amount)
results.generated_sql:

    c.customerid, 
    c.segment, 
    c.currency, 
    AVG(t.price / t.amount) AS average_price_per_item,

FROM 
    customers c

    transactions_1k t ON c.customerid = t.customerid
GROUP BY 
    c.customerid, 
    c.segment, 
    c.currency
ORDER BY 
    total_spending DESC
LIMIT 1;
